# YBV Studio • Free Offline Windows Software

> YBV Studio builds fast, free Windows desktop apps that run 100% offline on your PC with zero watermarks, zero subscriptions, and no mandatory accounts.

## Active Release: Orpheus (v1.0.10)

**Orpheus** by **YBV Studio** is a free, offline-first **AI video editor for Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit)**. Built for speed with GPU acceleration and on-device AI tools, it lets creators edit vertical Shorts, Reels, TikToks, and full-length YouTube videos without cloud limits, watermarks, or monthly fees.

- **Website:** https://hertzwag.github.io/Orpheus/
- **Direct Windows x64 Installer (39 MB):** https://github.com/hertzwaG/Orpheus/releases/download/v1.0.10/Orpheus-v1.0.10-Setup.exe
- **GitHub Releases:** https://github.com/hertzwaG/Orpheus/releases
- **GitHub Page:** https://github.com/hertzwaG/Orpheus
- **Current Version:** 1.0.10
- **Price:** 100% free desktop app with no subscriptions and zero watermarks

### Orpheus Core Features
- **Creator Mode (AI-Assisted):** Local AI subtitles offline with zero cloud limits, smart 9:16 vertical framing for Shorts/Reels, and AI prompt editing to cut silences, add hooks, and style clips.
- **Studio Mode (Pro Timeline):** Multi-track video and audio timeline, one-click automatic AI silence removal, live color grading, transitions, visual effects, and fast watermark-free MP4 export.

### Windows System Requirements
- **OS:** Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
- **Processor:** Modern 4-core Intel or AMD CPU
- **Memory:** 8 GB RAM (16 GB recommended for 4K video)
- **Graphics:** Vulkan or DirectX 12 compatible GPU
- **Installer Size:** 39 MB (`Orpheus-v1.0.10-Setup.exe`)
- **Internet Connection:** Not required for editing, AI tools, auto-captions, or MP4 exports
